title: When switching to Claude Code, I didn't
text:
When switching to Claude Code, I didn't like that it would update files with no good way of tracking changes. I missed Cursor's inline diffs, file tracking, and the ability to accept or reject individual changes.
So I built a tool that intercepts Claude Code's file writes using a PreToolUse hook, rendering them as inline diffs with accept/reject controls before anything is written.
Free to use here or on the VS Code Extension Marketplace:
https://
norrin.dev
